fact: The Assistant Minister for information systems said a tender for digitising 500 primary care units was awaiting technical and financial award, and that all about 4,000 health units outside universal health insurance should be digitised within two to three years.
title: ميكنة 4 آلاف وحدة صحية.. واعتماد الذكاء الاصطناعى فى المستشفيات
